title: Why AI Can’t Replace Engineering Teams
caption:
Why is your engineering team taking so long? It's not because they are slow—it's because a demo is not the same as a production-ready system. Here is why the iceberg is much deeper than the prompt.

Source: Spectrum - Why AI Can’t Replace Engineering Teams

https://spectrum.ieee.org/engineering-jobs-that-ai-cant-replace
